description: An operator agent embedding chief (Cuneiform's roadmap → tasklists → `chief run` loop) needs to turn a product roadmap into `tasks/chief/NN-slug.json` tasklists PROGRAMMATICALLY — with the numbered bands, `branchName: chief/NN-slug`, `dependsOn` (filename-minus-.json, cross-repo `<repo>:<name>`), and `touches` conventions correct — rather than hand-writing JSON. This tasklist adds a supported generator with a CONCRETE input contract: a roadmap JSON document `{"phases": [{"name", "items": [...]}]}` where each item carries `title` (required), `description` (required), `scope` (optional prose folded into the description), `deps` (optional array of tasklist stems, `<repo>:<stem>` for cross-repo), `touches` (optional array of conflict domains), and `iters` (optional integer) — and it emits one schema-valid tasklist file per item, per `docs/tasklist-schema.md`, callable by an embedding host. It is the operation the Cuneiform Chief-in-Riju phase (cuneiform G8) calls, so the input shape is a published contract, not an internal detail. Scope: a generator command/helper (under `bin/`/`engine/`), `docs/`, and a hermetic test.

userStories.title: A generator that emits schema-valid tasklists from a roadmap
userStories.description: Given a structured roadmap input, emit one schema-valid `tasks/chief/NN-slug.json` per item.
acceptanceCriteria: A supported command/helper (e.g. `chief gen <roadmap-file>`, or a documented `engine/` script) takes a roadmap JSON in the contract shape (`phases[]` → `items[]`, each item with `title`/`description` required and `scope`/`deps`/`touches`/`iters` optional) and emits one `tasks/chief/<NN-slug>.json` per item, each valid against `docs/tasklist-schema.md`: `project`, `branchName: chief/<NN-slug>`, `description`, and `userStories` each with `acceptanceCriteria` + `passes:false`
Numbering is non-colliding: the generator inspects existing `tasks/chief/*.json` + `tasks/chief/completed/*.json` and continues the band ABOVE the current max
It writes files for review by default and never overwrites an existing tasklist without an explicit `--force`; a `--dry-run`/stdout mode emits without writing
Bash 3.2 compatible (or, if a helper language is used, it ships with the engine and needs no new runtime beyond `jq`); `bash -n` + `shellcheck -S error` clean on any shell it adds

userStories.title: Faithful to the tasklist conventions
userStories.description: The generated files must obey the exact conventions the schema doc and the tasklist gate enforce.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated `branchName` == `chief/<name>`; `dependsOn` entries are filenames-minus-`.json` (never branch names), cross-repo-qualified `<repo>:<name>` where the roadmap declares a cross-repo dependency — matching `docs/tasklist-schema.md` and `docs/cross-repo-dependencies.md`
`touches` and `iters` are populated from the roadmap item where given, with sensible defaults otherwise
Every generated file passes `jq -e .` and the tasklist gate: valid JSON, `branchName == chief/NN-slug`, `mergedToMain` absent (not yet merged)

userStories.title: Document the input shape + test the generator
userStories.description: Document the roadmap input contract an embedding agent produces, and pin the generator with a fixture test.
acceptanceCriteria: `docs/` documents the roadmap-input contract NORMATIVELY (the operation an embedding agent — cuneiform G8's operator loop — calls to author tasklists): a JSON document whose top level is `phases[]`, each phase `{"name": string, "items": [...]}`, each item `{"title": string (required), "description": string (required), "scope": string (optional), "deps": ["<stem>"|"<repo>:<stem>"] (optional), "touches": [string] (optional), "iters": integer (optional)}` — with the mapping of each field onto the emitted tasklist (`title`→slug + story seed, `description`+`scope`→`description`, `deps`→`dependsOn`, `touches`→`touches`, `iters`→`iters`) and the defaulting rules for every optional field stated explicitly

Unknown top-level or item fields are rejected (or warned on) by the generator rather than silently dropped, so the contract stays honest as embedding hosts evolve; the doc includes one complete worked example roadmap JSON and the file(s) it generates

A hermetic test runs the generator on a small fixture roadmap and asserts the emitted files are schema-valid, numbered in a non-colliding band, carry correct `branchName`/`dependsOn`, and round-trip through `jq`
